full_judgment:
4. Mr. M.A. Wahab Miah, learned Advocate along with Mr. Enayetur Rahim appeared on behalf of the appellant. Mr. M.A. Wahab Miah submits that the story of the dying declaration is not genuine as the maker there of could not after sustaining two fatal injuries on the head, have the physical capability of making any statement. He further submits that the prosecution case is not trustworthy inasmuch as they have failed to examine any independent witness in support of their case and that the witnesses examined are related to the appellant or interested Witnesses. He further submits that in view of admitted enmity between the parties there was an imperative need for corroboration of the prosecution case by independent evidence which is absent in the present case Mr. Wahab further submits that some important witnesses were not examined by the prosecution and this non-examination raises the presumption against the prosecution case. Mr. Wahab has further submitted that inordinate delay in lodging the F.I.R. left a scope for fabrication. 

 14. Mr. M.A. Wahab Miah has submitted that in this case the prosecution has failed to examine some of the important and vital witnesses like Mofizuddin, Karim and Mozaffar. Similarly the prosecution has failed to examine night guard Abdur Rahman of bizul Family planning office and his wife Sufia, The non-examination of these witnesses raises presumption against the prosecution under section 114, illustration (g) of the Evidence Act. In this connection we may also note the fact that the witnesses proving the dying declaration, namely, P.Ws. 1, 2, 3, 4 and 10 are either related to the informant or are interested witnesses, because the accused persons are witnesses in some criminal cases filed against the informant and these witnesses.
